name: Nell Wicker
source_profile:
Nell Wicker (CN) — Proprietor of the Split Stag

Nell is a sharp-witted widow who has operated the Split Stag since before Thornhollow became the seat of a marquisate. Her public house has long been a gathering place for woodcutters, wagon drivers, hunters, merchants, and other travelers moving through the northeastern forests.

A shrewd businesswoman with an extensive network of acquaintances, Nell possesses an extraordinary knowledge of local gossip, unpaid debts, and the movements of travelers along the forest roads. She is generally friendly with Sheriff Cormac Baird, although she frequently complains that his deputies interfere with business when attempting to break up drunken arguments.

Nell has little affection for the marquessa's increasingly formal administration and frequently allows independent woodcutters and dissatisfied laborers to hold meetings in her establishment. Nevertheless, she maintains that her principal concern is the continued prosperity of the Split Stag rather than any particular political cause.

Her establishment occasionally attracts former soldiers whose loyalties remain uncertain, and she has become adept at recognizing the difference between men seeking an honest drink and those looking to recruit companions for more dangerous enterprises. Although Nell has no desire to become involved in the affairs of the Lost Banners, she is reluctant to betray customers whose only apparent crime is having fought on the losing side of the war.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 114 (source excerpt; may be partial)
